subject: table: fix wrong handle comparation in index double write (#57418)
summary: Reviewed the kv/table changes: `PartitionHandle.Equal` now falls back to comparing the underlying handle when the other side isn’t a `PartitionHandle`, fixing asymmetric equality that could mis-handle global-index/temp-index duplicate and delete checks during double write. No remaining Blocker/High correctness or consistency issues found in the kv/table scope, and the same `PartitionHandle.Equal` behavior remains on `upstream/master`.
